client_factory.path: A40DF0 reference -> A4C250 -> A4C030 -> A5DE34 -> A5E844; caller A40DF0 not re-expanded.
client_factory.mode: A4C0EA pushes EBX=0 as first argument. A5DE34 forwards its mode unchanged. Observed Original E8/xrefs have one caller of each open/create entry, and no absolute pointer bytes to those entries.
client_factory.owner: A4C030 allocates actual 2Ch endpoint, opens mode 0, establishes capacities/buffers and starts its worker before output publication. GameNativeOnlineProcess builds retained adapters/globals/runtime; it does not create an endpoint or peer.
client_factory.failure: A negative open or subsequent creation failure retains the existing cleanup and _exit(0); no ignore-failure or offline fallback is added.

name_and_server_contract.client_pid: A5E557 snapshots processes, identifies current PID, opens its parent with 400h query access, requires parent creation time strictly older, then publishes that parent PID; otherwise leaves output untouched and returns error.
name_and_server_contract.server_pid: Any nonzero mode takes GetCurrentProcessId in A5E844. The branch exists in the Original and current Source; it is not restricted to numeric 1.
name_and_server_contract.server_transport: CreateNamedPipeW(name, 40080003h, 6, 1, 400h, 400h, 5000, security); deny network SID, allow logon SID. Client opens existing overlapped duplex pipe and requests message read mode.
name_and_server_contract.not_bootstrap: The helper creates a pipe/protocol transport owner. No observed title-specific caller selects server mode, owns a compatible request/reply loop, launches the game as its child or retains that service through the child lifetime.
name_and_server_contract.protocol_admission_from_existing_Source: Current native_online_ipc.cpp encodes an 8-byte marker/counter request, advances counter/phase, and accepts only an 8-byte response with marker 8 and complemented response value equal to the current counter. Protocol framing/encoding, asynchronous exchange and timeout/cleanup behavior also apply. No server implementation is inferred from this client contract.
name_and_server_contract.naming_provenance: XLive/BSP names are analyst hypotheses, not recovered vendor symbols; the generic helper and parent-PID shape do not establish a Microsoft GFWL server.

launcher_candidates.Original_shell_import: Only observed ShellExecuteExA call is A3E5B7 in complete 106-byte A3E560. It uses caller-supplied executable/parameters, zeroed 3Ch request, verb open, mask400, show5; sole observed caller A40492 lies in notification drain. Current Source for that consumer calls update.exe with its path parameter, sleeps 200ms and exits. This is an update-launch consumer, not an identified pre-constructor parent server; the notification pump can also run inside construction.
launcher_candidates.Original_CreateProcessA_import: Three observed read/call sites C02C75/C02DE5 in CRT C0297A and C2A7B7 in CRT C2A630. Indexed caller chains include Lua io_popen and generic CRT spawn wrappers. Their existence does not identify a game-specific peer producer or rule out dynamically supplied commands.
launcher_candidates.command_line: Current parse_command_line_0073ce20 Source handles caching/zip/frame/log/freecam, ip/localport/connectport/debug, auto packaging/tests and memlimit options. No server/peer switch is present in that existing Source contract. Quoted Original parser literals corroborate a subset; this is not proof that no other component handles a launch switch.
launcher_candidates.current_launcher: scripts/run.ps1 prepares the pinned genuine GFWL runtime and starts bsp_game.exe with runtime/settings/render options. Its code supplies no named-pipe server. The separate native-data suspended-child bootstrap owns data-band admission/handoff, and no pipe open/create call was found there.
launcher_candidates.installed_update: Game-root update.exe version resource describes an update launcher; its inspected import table and bounded string inventory provide no matching named-pipe producer. No body-level bootstrap contract was established for this external image.
launcher_candidates.installed_sus_prog: Unversioned AMD64 image with a Rust debug-build PDB path; no matching pipe import/string in the bounded inventory. It has no established Original-game provenance and is not admitted as a peer.
launcher_candidates.installed_GFWL: System xlive.dll SHA79da26ab6b2dc25936c3354087de0ba41da1a8b62924972e9100c29b95d34385 equals the repository verified redistributable payload. It and GFWLClient.exe contain a different \\.\pipe\GFWLive\ namespace. No matching parent-PID protocol/bootstrap was identified from these bounded imports/strings.
launcher_candidates.installed_override: Game-root xlive.dll identifies itself in version resources as AlterBSP/XLiveLessNess; its identity is retained separately and cannot establish the genuine SDK/peer contract.

No Source ownership or launcher packet is ready solely from this evidence.
